laura_finance: BrightLabs opened a dispute: Feb invoice shows a big spike on 2026-02-15, they suspect duplicate streaming tokens.
sam_support: Customer says: '2.1M tokens on /v1/streams that day vs ~200k normally. Please pause charges while you look.'
ivan_runtime: We had a tiny deploy at ~03:12 UTC that changed stream ACK persistence keys briefly; canary flagged duplicate emits.
ivan_runtime: quick log lines:
[2026-02-15T03:12:10Z] req=rx_A emit=1200 seq=5
[2026-02-15T03:12:11Z] disconnect session=se-21
[2026-02-15T03:12:12Z] resume emit=1200 seq=5
emma_sre: Rollback happened at 03:14 UTC. Window ~2 mins. I'll pull deploy tags and impacted accounts.
olga_prodops: Scope first. If isolated to BrightLabs, finance can provisionally credit pending audit. If many tenants, need wider backfill plan.
sam_support: BrightLabs provided three request_ids for cross-check.
ivan_runtime: Plan: run readonly de-dupe query on event_seq within 03:10-03:16 UTC, then build correction rows for billing ingest. Est discovery 30-60m, correction write 1-2h.
billing-bot: Created ticket CB-4120 linked to invoice INV-2026-02-BL.
laura_finance: Approving provisional credit up to $20k pending verification. Require audit artifacts: query output and token->USD math.
ivan_runtime: Will post readonly counts in ~45m. Starting discovery now.
sam_support: Noted; I'll tell the customer we provisionally paused billing and will confirm once verification completes.
